description: Defines various response classes for the Spark REST application submission protocol, including success, error, and status responses.

classes.name: SubmitRestProtocolResponse
classes.description: Abstract base class for all REST response messages in Spark deployment, includes common fields and validation.

classes.name: CreateSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Response class for create submission requests, extends SubmitRestProtocolResponse.

classes.name: KillSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Response class for kill submission requests, extends SubmitRestProtocolResponse.

classes.name: KillAllSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Response class for kill all submissions, extends SubmitRestProtocolResponse.

classes.name: ClearResponse
classes.description: Response class for clear requests, extends SubmitRestProtocolResponse.

classes.name: ReadyzResponse
classes.description: Response class for readiness check requests, extends SubmitRestProtocolResponse.

classes.name: SubmissionStatusResponse
classes.description: Response class for status requests, includes submission ID, driver state, worker ID, and host port.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Error response message, includes highest protocol version and message.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Performs validation of response fields, ensuring required fields are set.
